title: Request Intake
description: Normalizes the user request into a bounded intake fact set before any gate decision.
outcome: Normalized typed intake record with structured intent, outcome, constraints, exclusions, entry_guards, and reason_codes.
constraints: Input must be provided via the canonical request shape.
Ambiguous or conflicting signals must cause fail-closed rejection.
Typed intake fields must remain bounded to the existing node family.

source_resolution.intent: Typed contract: normalize actor/request/task/repository intent without inventing missing facts.

reason_codes.INTAKE_MALFORMED_INPUT: Request structure is invalid or missing required fields.
reason_codes.INTAKE_AMBIGUOUS_INTENT: Request contains conflicting intent or scope signals.
reason_codes.INTAKE_SCOPE_DRIFT: Requested scope exceeds the node family boundary.
reason_codes.INTAKE_MISSING_IDENTITY: Request identity (actor/source) is missing or malformed.
reason_codes.INTAKE_MISSING_TASK_BINDING: Task binding is missing or ambiguous.
reason_codes.INTAKE_MISSING_REPOSITORY_INTENT: Repository intent is missing or ambiguous.
reason_codes.INTAKE_MISSING_REQUESTED_OUTCOME: Requested outcome is missing or ambiguous.
reason_codes.INTAKE_AUTHORITY_INTENT_DETECTED: Request text implies merge/deploy/production authority; recorded only, not promoted.
reason_codes.INTAKE_REPLAY_IDEMPOTENT: Same normalized request replayed yields identical digest and no duplicate effect.
reason_codes.INTAKE_HUMAN_REQUIRED: Human input required to resolve missing fields or confirm authority intent.
